notes: Sources: FY2019 10-K (spgi-20191231x10k.htm, filed 2020-02-10) and FY2025 10-K (spgi-20251231.htm, filed 2026-02-11), saved in _ingest/raw/audit/edgar/. FY2019 is the pre-IHS Markit basis (4 segments: Ratings, Market Intelligence, Platts, Indices); the IHS Markit merger (Feb 2022) added Mobility, Engineering Solutions (sold 2023) and expanded MI and Platts (renamed Commodity Insights, and in the FY2025 10-K the segment is called 'Energy'). Segment figures include intersegment revenue (mainly the Ratings royalty charged to MI); summing segments and the elimination line gives total revenue. 'level' = segment | sub | adjustment; sub-lines are the revenue-type disaggregation and must not be added to segment totals. No sector split (corporates/financials/structured/governments) for Ratings is given in the note table. FY2025 risk factors: 32 headings under Item 1A in three groups (Cybersecurity, Technology & Innovation; Legal & Regulatory; Business & Operational). Headings >40 words truncated with '…'.
